Docs pages render this; prose never restates these facts inline. Pilot note: this file currently carries the rfdetr slice only, written from libreyolo dev @ 91b3518, docs/export_support.md, the HF org listing (265 repos), and vision-analysis generated/verified-results.v1.json.

upstream.bibtex_verified: 2026-08-08, copied verbatim from the Citation section of the upstream README on branch develop. Cross-checked against the arXiv API for 2511.09554: five authors, accepted to ICLR 2026. Do not hand-edit; a wrong citation misattributes someone's work.

detect.tensorrt: Runtime parity coverage lives in tests/e2e/test_tensorrt.py.
detect.openvino: Runtime parity coverage lives in tests/e2e/test_openvino.py.
detect.coreml: Conversion is available, but runtime parity requires a macOS runner.
detect.ncnn: The DETR family is blocked on ncnn framework-wide.

segment.tensorrt: A published Apache-2.0 trained segmentation checkpoint exports and reloads, but public top-k class membership changes.
segment.openvino: After Hungarian query alignment, the converted-runtime element match rate is 69.0%, below the validation bar.
segment.tflite: onnx2tf 2.4.x assigns an invalid NHWC layout to the segmentation-head Einsum (78 channels versus the required 256), so conversion fails.

pose.tensorrt: A published Apache-2.0 trained pose checkpoint exports and reloads, but matched public boxes fall to 0.704 IoU with 41.4-pixel coordinate drift.
pose.openvino: After Hungarian query alignment, the converted-runtime element match rate is 72.75%, below the validation bar.

obb.tensorrt: A deterministic synthetic OBB fixture exports and reloads, but public top-k class membership changes.
obb.openvino: After Hungarian query alignment, the converted-runtime element match rate is 91.25%, below the validation bar.
